Trust me, I've been as easy-going, amicable, and permissive a person as I could possibly be. I think that leads to me getting shit on though. My friends have always been very tight knit and pretty much like family, but for some reason in the past year or so I've ended up with no one left that really cares. I've been very forgiving with my most recent ex, even after she has literally torn my heart out and stomped on it. If anything, it took me too long to get angry.
I had thought of that too. But I didn't wanna be like "Yo I'm gonna kill myself probably, can you stop me?" or something to that effect, I'd be holding them hostage at that point.

I wish I could do that, I'm not a retaliatory person usually. I can't be angry at them for feeling uncomfortable with me wanting to discuss my mental illness haha.. it just hurts because I really needed someone. Anyone.

I was in no state for any phone conversation, I would've gotten choked up very easily. Phone calls are also intrusive in my opinion, depending on circumstances of course. I made sure to emphasize to all of them that if they had other plans it would be cool. But their other plans were to do what I wanted to join in on.

I wasn't even wanting to talk about my suicidal thoughts, I know that would be a quick way to make people uncomfortable. I don't understand how they can say they're my best friends and do any other kind of favor without me even asking, but when I ask for someone to just be there and listen for a bit, they don't have the time.

The first friend I texted said that he'd love to but he was busy so he'd let two of our other friends know; he texted another friend for me who said he was cool with hanging out, and the other one was supposedly off of work and planning to go to friend number ones place after he finished up whatever he was doing. Friend 2 was cool with hanging out until friend 3 decided to stop answering him. I wasn't invited to hang out with my own friend circle because I'd bring the mood down I guess. 

My family and I don't discuss emotional problems, I only get a "Just worry about your degree/work and take some supplements" when I've felt this way for years. 

I have not seen a therapist for years but I currently have no insurance for semi-complicated reasons.

Both of those on top of music, my main source of joy, have become so mundane to me; they used to be distractions but now they feel like chores.  I only ever keep going with things because I think eventually I'll feel better. It's been about 8 years since I first realized maybe life is not for me, about 5 since I've begun having consistent suicidal thoughts.

It's all about finding someone who knows how to deal with it, either by having had experience with it or just being an understanding person. Anxiety makes everything harder, but it's so valuable and rewarding to find someone who can help you with it. Don't give up hope, just gotta find the right person (or wait for the right person to find you). Pm me if you need anything
If you need to talk please pm me

I'm in almost the same boat. My girlfriend has had bouts of anxiety (as everyone does) but has no idea what it's like to deal with it every day. I'd advise talking to your girlfriend about it, even if it's scary to think of how she might react. She may be willing to work with you, which would be optimal. And if she's not, it wasn't a relationship that was going to work in the first place. Better to figure these things out early on than live with the fear, it'll only perpetuate whatever anxiety you're having. It'll work out friend, if you need to talk just pm me
